subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 20, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - October 20, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. Our team has been working hard to bring you the best possible experience with our Arch-based Linux distribution. In this newsletter, we'll highlight some of the recent developments and achievements.

Firstly, we're thrilled to announce that the Linux Plumbers Conference videos are now available. This is a great resource for anyone interested in learning more about the latest developments in the Linux community. You can access the videos on the Linux Plumbers Conference website.

In terms of security, we've been keeping an eye on the latest updates from AlmaLinux and Debian. AlmaLinux has released security updates for idm, kernel, libsoup, perl-URI, python3.14-urllib3, and webkit2gtk3, while Debian has issued updates for apache2, cifs-utils, haproxy, jq, and more. We recommend keeping your system up to date to ensure the best possible security.

On the development front, our community has been busy working on various projects. The acreetion-surf v2.0.0 has been committed, and we're excited to see the new features and improvements. Additionally, cobra3282000 has made significant contributions to the project, including fixing a geocode-glib update conflict and making changes to Calamares to force Wayland as the default desktop environment.

We'd like to extend a special thank you to our community members who have been actively contributing to the project. Your hard work and dedication are invaluable to us, and we're grateful for your involvement.

As always, we're committed to providing a secure and private Linux distribution that meets the needs of our users. We're proud to be a community-driven project, and we're excited to see what the future holds.

In other news, we've been working on improving our infrastructure to ensure that our users have the best possible experience. We're constantly monitoring our systems and making adjustments as needed to ensure that our services remain fast and reliable.

If you're interested in getting involved with the AcreetionOS project, we invite you to join our community on Discord. This is a great way to connect with other users and developers, ask questions, and contribute to the project.

Finally, we'd like to remind you that our GitLab instance is available for anyone to use. You can access it at gitlab.acreetionos.org, and we encourage you to explore the various projects and repositories available.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds, and we're grateful for your support.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
